ledger_reason: Kirkaldy measurement uncertainty is UNKNOWN (not admitted); the preregistered rule keeps the gate MISSING whatever the outcome

mapping.IDENTIFIABILITY_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE, no set FAILS, and a set is NOT_ASSESSABLE
mapping.MODEL_REJECTED: IDENTIFIABLE and the primary or secondary set FAILS for the 1RC
mapping.MODEL_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE, and the primary and secondary sets PASS for the 1RC
mapping.ledger_rule: an outcome is a report, not a promotion. independent_validation may PASS only on MODEL_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED AND with an admitted measurement uncertainty for THIS dataset; Kirkaldy's is UNKNOWN, so the gate stays MISSING unless the owner admits one

reading.applicability_not_enforced_by_the_route: the SOC scope is enforced by the role builder only; the route's validity domain does not carry it
reading.blindness_spent: the held-out cells were partly unblinded while building the roles (raw step edges of the Expt 2,2 cells were read; on-load drops seen before the calibration fit, which had no free choice left) and fully opened by the evaluation; a later evaluation on them (for example after an owner-admitted measurement uncertainty widens the domain) would not be blind and must say so. A blind cross-cell verdict needs cells not yet opened
reading.descriptive_only: NOT preregistered, NO verdict: on the in-domain windows only, the 1RC errors are 9.5 / 19.5 mV (primary, 67 windows; load-only 10.2 / 19.7) and 11.8 / 21.1 mV (secondary, 9 windows from 3 cells). The subset is not neutral: the excluded windows carry larger errors (full primary set 11.1 mV). A post-hoc subset selected after the held-out cells were opened cannot replace the preregistered set
hypotheses_not_evidence: the held-out rigs (experiments 1 and 2,2) ran colder at times than the calibration rigs
Expt 2,2/D's larger strict-transfer error tracks its lower own capacity (Q_own below Q_cal)
reading.not_assessable: neither held-out set can support or contradict the model: 32 of 99 primary and 8 of 17 secondary windows leave the unwidened calibration domain (23.19-29.66 degC, <= 2.5017 A): held-out cells ran as cold as 17.61 degC, and the held-out pulse current exceeds the calibration maximum by up to 0.52 mA in some windows. The preregistration keeps the range unwidened because the BioLogic accuracy is not admitted; it is not widened after the fact
reading.not_tested: other temperatures, ageing, charge, drive cycles, currents other than 2.5 A, SOC below the scope; the pulse current equals the calibration current, so this is cross-cell transfer, not current extrapolation
reading.supported: R0, R1, C1 and tau are IDENTIFIABLE from the 25-pulse GITT windows of 7 calibration cells in three experiments (cell-block bootstrap CV 6.1 % at most), with the calibration-mean measured OCV fixed
reading.what_an_admitted_accuracy_would_and_woul: an owner-admitted cycler current accuracy could cover the sub-mA current excess, but NOT the temperature gap (several degC, and the thermocouple is not the cycler's current channel): 25 primary windows are outside on temperature, so the primary set would stay NOT_ASSESSABLE. Closing the temperature gap needs calibration data that spans the held-out temperatures, or held-out cells inside the calibrated range, under a new preregistration

scope: LG M50T at 25 degC base cooling, beginning of life; 2.5 A discharge pulses and rests; SOC >= max(0.10, lowest knot); held-out cells from experiments 1 and 2,2
